review_mode: independent full static source, protocol, candidate, gate-interface, and launcher-compatibility review

checks.evidence: All four requested SHA-256 identities equal the current file bytes; the freeze tool pins the candidate and generation gate identities.

Both the candidate generation root and fixed execution_01 root are resolved, required absent, and checked for equality plus both ancestor directions against --out before output.mkdir; the same check is repeated inside prepare/attach and before a success status.

Before attach creates any output directory, it resolves and hashes the supplied core and requires that core's output_root to resolve to the single candidate-reserved generation root; attach repeats the same binding against the same core bytes.

Attach reconstructs the entire freeze_preparation object from fixed candidate/tool identities and the active top-level S39 manifest, four evidence records, and loading review, including all zero-execution counters and purpose; exact dictionary equality rejects missing, extra, or contradictory fields before review attachment.

Prepare derives components/config/input only from the hash-recorded S39 manifest, calls the S39 metadata gate, and requires the four loading records plus differently reviewed loading evidence to cross-bind the same manifest, resource core, source, one factory call, zero generation/codec requests, complete state-dict loads, VAE loading information, and no external-launch failure markers.

Success is assigned only after the core or final manifest is written and all corresponding validation and final freshness checks return. Any caught exception after the exclusive output directory is created overwrites CHECKING or a partial path with NOT_READY; source/protocol drift overwrites any success with FAILED. A failed directory remains exclusive and cannot be overwritten.

The two roles require distinct status strings and both bind the exact variant and canonical core SHA. Review receipts are the only excluded canonical fields; the final manifest file SHA is then sent to the S40 metadata gate before the attach receipt can report its success status.

The candidate schema, frozen status, runtime, limits, fixed output_root, and bound S40 source identities match the derived launcher's read_frozen and CLI interface. Static AST inspection found the expected one HERE assignment, two resource-gate routes, one runtime-factory route, and exact status-label occurrence counts 1,1,1,1,3,2,2 against the pinned S35 launcher.

The freeze source AST contains standard-library imports only and no subprocess, model, runtime-constructor, forward, navigation, or generation call. Prepare/attach use file hashes, JSON, stat metadata, and the metadata/loading-chain checks; they do not open any of the five component bodies.

observed_freshness.scope: Read-only observation; freshness must be checked again by prepare, attach, and launcher.

nonblocking_boundaries: Preflight rejection before the exclusive --out directory is created has no new receipt directory; it cannot leave a misleading success artifact.
Resolved-path checks assume the trusted local workspace does not adversarially retarget symlink parents between checks; the later launcher independently requires fresh fixed run roots.
Different human authorship is enforced by orchestration and recorded reviewer identity, while the machine gate enforces distinct roles, statuses, file hashes, variant, and core SHA.
This source PASS does not approve any future actual S40 core, attach operation, model loading, generation, output quality, exact-original identity, or novelty claim.
